source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB getter paired with separately governed setter.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x00/0x09 parameter 0x05/set0/block0; inspect byte 5; clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and byte 5 matches setting.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Fails to supply a parser despite read-only operation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with parameter/version/validity and boot flags decoding.
historical_reviews.history: Setter is separate and cannot be auto-invoked.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Read-only collection does not prove actual boot behavior.

original_test_intent: Read parameter-5 boot flags and validate their mode, persistence and selected boot device against the approved configuration.
original_method: Issue raw 0x00/0x09 for parameter 5 and inspect the response data.
manual_activity: Owner supplies expected parameter version/validity, mode, persistence and boot device once.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek unnecessarily leaves a standard read unimplemented.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x00/0x09 0x05 0x00 0x00 and a version-aware parser; never follow with a setter or restart.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Selector, set/block, Script and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the complete parameter response rather than accepting an unspecified byte offset.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds response framing and named-field acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Configuration readback does not prove a device actually boots.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stale/cleared flags or wrong byte indexing can create false conclusions.

project_override_considerations: A high-level getter is equivalent only if it exposes validity, persistence, mode and device fields with the same freshness.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and command align; byte-5 Criteria is underspecified but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read contract is clear; expected flags are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Replaces ambiguous byte-5 checking with schema-aware named-field decoding.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get Boot Options returns framing metadata plus parameter data, so a fixed human byte count is unsafe across output conventions. The parser must validate selector/version and then decode valid, persistent, EFI/legacy and device bits separately; it must not infer successful boot from configuration alone.
